general news.headline: Live: He is an illegal MP if 2024 polls were illegal, BJP hits back at Rahul GandhiINDIA Bloc Rally Live Updates: Delhi's Ramlila Maidan witnessed a massive show of opposition unity on Sunday as INDIA bloc leaders gathered for a mega rally against alleged electoral irregularities, accusing the Election Commission of facilitating "vote chori" and demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Addressing the gathering, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accused the BJP of manipulating electoral rolls and alleged that 15 per cent of voters had been removed after the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. He warned that Gyanesh Kumar would be removed from his post and sent to jail, adding that the opposition would not allow the Constitution to be destroyed. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav and National Conference president Farooq Abdullah also targeted the BJP and the Election Commission over alleged voter deletions and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Mamata vowed to continue the fight against SIR, while Akhilesh predicted the BJP's defeat in Uttar Pradesh in 2027. Several other opposition leaders, including Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy and Congress MP Shashi Tharoor, also addressed the gathering. India Today's Marya Shakil, Preeti Choudhry, Shreya Chatterjee and Shambhavi Srivastava are bringing you the latest developments and ground reports from Ramlila Maidan. Stay tuned to IndiaToday.in for live updates, key speeches, political reactions and minute-by-minute coverage of the INDIA bloc rally.
